title: 第15章 第二场赌斗第16章 胜利
content_zh:
一旁的徐博同样赚得盆满钵满，赶忙拉着江岳便准备离开。
两人刚转过身，尚未迈出废弃机库的阴影。
“这位兄弟，还请留步。”
一道带着戏谑的沙哑声音从侧后方横插进来。
江岳停下脚步。
一名光着膀子的老兵挡在退路上。此人正是先前在千钧桩上，用卸力技巧生生耗断新兵双腿的独腿老兵。
“小兄弟气血没散，连汗都没怎么出。”
老兵吐出一口烟圈，上下打量着江岳，“看样子还有余力，何不再来一场？”
江岳面无表情，没有回话。
老兵见状，指了指高台上的屠夫张，冷笑道：“只要张老大愿意开盘，上了场，无论胜负都有出场费拿。你一个新兵蛋子，白赚积分的事，亏不了你。”
听到这话，一旁的徐博脸色骤变。
他一把死死拽住江岳的作训服衣角，将其强行拉到一旁的角落中。
“别听他的，这是老兵油子惯用的伎俩！”
徐博压低声音，语速极快，透着焦急：“他们专门拉有点实力的新兵赌斗。知道为什么实力悬殊，屠夫张还愿意开盘吗？因为看的人多！”
“老兵碾压新兵，足够血腥，足够残暴。底下的赌徒就爱看这种单方面虐杀的戏码！”
徐博指了指场地边缘刚刚被抬走的那滩血迹，又开口道：“前几天那个新兵的下场你看到了，双腿骨裂退场。别以为上去随便应付一下就能拿了出场费认输。”
“上了场，就下不来！”
“如果谁都能随意认输，那岂不是可以联手外围疯狂押注自己输来套现？”
“屠夫张是一级武者！你有没有全力以赴，他那只独眼看得一清二楚。敢在台上假打糊弄庄家，他会亲自出手废了你。”
徐博喘了口气，继续说道：“前几天那个骨裂的新兵，上场前打的就是赚个出场费的主意。”

“没成想硬顶到最后，把自己搞残了，反倒影响后面的训练，保不齐就得被淘汰！”
江岳静静听完，微微点了点头。
底层逻辑很清晰。
双方实力悬殊，却依旧开盘，是因为这种猎杀戏码能极大地刺激赌徒的感官。
有人看，就会有大量的积分流入盘口。作为庄家的屠夫张，自然能够从中抽取丰厚的流水抽成。
这套规则可谓残酷。
江岳转过头。
他的视线越过徐博的肩膀，犹如实质般落在那个独腿老兵身上。
目光从老兵的胸腔起伏、肌肉密度，一路扫至对方那条简易金属义肢的承重节点。
对方会卸力，气血底蕴也远超王猛。
若是真正的生死搏杀，江岳绝无可能是其对手。
但如果只是比拼在重压之下的忍耐力……
江岳摸了摸自己那层暗青色的、经过无数次极限锤打的【韧皮】。
“可以一较。”
“如果输了，以我的恢复能力，损失相对来说也可以接受......”
江岳拨开徐博的手，重新走回光亮处。
他看着独腿老兵，声音平静得不带一丝起伏，径直走向高台的方向。
“开盘吧。”
江岳与独腿老兵一前一后，来到高台铁案前。
content_en:
Xu Bo on the side also made a lot of money and hurriedly pulled Jiang Yue to leave.
The two had just turned around, but had not yet stepped out of the shadow of the abandoned hangar.
"Brother, please stay."
A joking, hoarse voice cut in from the side and behind.
Jiang Yue stopped.
A shirtless veteran blocked the retreat. This person was the one-legged veteran who had used force-relieving techniques to completely destroy the legs of the new recruits on the critical pile.
"My little brother's blood has not dissipated, and he hasn't even broken out much sweat."
The veteran blew out a smoke ring and looked Jiang Yue up and down, "It looks like he still has some energy left, why not try again?"
Jiang Yue's face was expressionless and he didn't reply.
Seeing this, the veteran pointed at the butcher Zhang on the high platform and sneered: "As long as Boss Zhang is willing to open the market and play, no matter whether he wins or loses, he will get an appearance fee. You are a new recruit and you can earn points for nothing. I can't lose you."
Hearing this, Xu Bo's expression suddenly changed.
He grabbed the corners of Jiang Yue's training uniform and forced him to the corner.
"Don't listen to him, this is a trick used by veterans!"
Xu Bo lowered his voice and spoke very fast, showing anxiety: "They specialize in recruiting relatively capable recruits to bet. Knowing why there is such a disparity in strength, is Butcher Zhang still willing to open the betting? Because there are so many people watching!"
"The veterans crush the new recruits, it's bloody and cruel enough. The gamblers below love to watch this kind of one-sided killing show!"
Xu Bo pointed to the pool of blood that had just been taken away from the edge of the field, and said again: "You saw what happened to that recruit a few days ago. He left the field with broken legs. Don't think that you can just take the appearance fee and give up if you just deal with it casually."
“Once you get on the court, you can’t get off!”
"If anyone can admit defeat at will, wouldn't it be possible to join forces with outsiders and bet wildly on their own losses to cash out?"
"Butcher Zhang is a first-level warrior! His one eye can clearly see whether you have gone all out. If you dare to pretend to fool the dealer on stage, he will personally kill you."
Xu Bo took a breath and continued: "The recruit with a broken bone a few days ago was just trying to earn an appearance fee before he came on the field."
"I didn't want to push myself until the end and cripple myself. It will affect the subsequent training. If I don't keep it, I will be eliminated!"
Jiang Yue listened quietly and nodded slightly.
The underlying logic is very clear.
There is a huge disparity in strength between the two sides, but they still open the market because this kind of hunting drama can greatly stimulate the gamblers' senses.
If someone watches, a large amount of points will flow into the handicap. As the banker, Butcher Zhang can naturally draw a generous commission from the business.
This set of rules can be described as cruel.
Jiang Yue turned his head.
His eyes crossed Xu Bo's shoulders and fell on the one-legged veteran as if they were real.
His eyes swept from the veteran's chest rise and fall, muscle density, all the way to the load-bearing nodes of the opponent's simple metal prosthetic leg.
The other party can shed his strength, and his Qi and blood foundation far exceeds that of Wang Meng.
If it were a real life and death fight, Jiang Yue would never be his opponent.
But if it's just a competition of endurance under heavy pressure...
Jiang Yue touched his dark blue [bast] that had been hammered to the limit countless times.
"We can compete."
"If I lose, with my ability to recover, the loss will be relatively acceptable..."
Jiang Yue pushed Xu Bo's hand away and walked back to the light.
He looked at the one-legged veteran, his voice was calm without any fluctuation, and he walked straight towards the high platform.
"Let's open the market."
Jiang Yue and the one-legged veteran came to the Gaotai Iron Case one after another.
